feedback: Not good. The expressive variant again just adds these odd short sounds.
scope: Rejects the expressive-attack variant; the subtle integrated-width opening remains liked.
mechanism: Three short foreground pitch/waveform attacks (+12,+7,+3,base; saw to pulse) instead of the source attacks.
designLesson: Moving short effects from an extra voice into the lead did not resolve the perceptual complaint. Treat sustained musical character and phrase-level organization as the next design question; do not equate brief parameter excursions with the intended experimental character.
nextExperiment: A bounded running passage with sustained rhythmic support/articulation, no short pitch effects, compared with the same initialized passage from the accepted full arrangement.

modelAssistanceReview.reason: Human rejection is explicit; previous models have no calibrated criterion for integration or odd sound effects. Register correctness did not predict musical success.
